codeReview.summary: Implementation fully satisfies all expected behaviors. POST /api/v1/evaluations correctly validates model and dataset fields, checks against supported lists, creates DB record with status=pending, sets Redis status, and returns 202 Accepted with UUID v4 task_id and Location header.

issues.description: Redundant validation: Gin binding already validates required fields via `binding:"required"` tag, but manual empty string checks at lines 91-104 are also performed. This doesn't cause bugs but is unnecessary code duplication.

Fragile Gin error message parsing: Uses `strings.Contains(errMsg, "Model")` to detect field validation errors. If Gin changes error message format in a future version, this could break. Consider using a more robust validation error detection approach.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker followed the backend-worker skill procedure correctly. All steps were followed: TDD approach (tests first), proper error handling, context propagation, Redis/PostgreSQL integration, and verification commands.
No convention violations detected. Worker correctly followed AGENTS.md patterns: repository interfaces, context passing, error handling with never-ignored errors, Gin handler pattern.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Code follows repository pattern, uses context.Context, proper error handling

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker used docker exec commands for verification (psql, redis-cli) that are consistent with services.yaml setup but not explicitly documented there. The services.yaml documents how to start postgres/redis but doesn't list verification commands.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Verification used: docker exec eval-postgres psql -c 'SELECT...', docker exec eval-redis redis-cli GET...

summary: Implementation passes all requirements. CreateEvaluation endpoint correctly returns 202 with UUID v4 task_id, Location header, validates required fields (model, dataset) returning 400 with error messages, validates model/dataset against supported lists returning 400 with valid_models/valid_datasets, creates DB record with status=pending, and sets Redis status to pending. Tests cover all validation contract assertions (VAL-API-001 through VAL-API-007). Two minor non-blocking issues noted: redundant manual validation after Gin binding, and fragile Gin error message parsing.
